# opnsense_firewall_nat_settings (Resource)

Singleton OPNsense outbound source NAT settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Outbound source NAT rule generation mode. Must be `automatic`, `hybrid`, `advanced`, or `disabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton resource identifier.
